ground_truth: The ball constantly falls on the spring board and triggers it. As soon the blimp reaches it the spring board triggers a diagonal fly
response:
Because it was resting on a curved surface (the arch). The blimp has an upward buoyant force, but if its hull is touching a sloped/curved object that force is redirected by the contact normal and gives a horizontal component. The tiny sideways push (and any small offset of the blimp’s center) makes it slide off and rise at an angle.

Fixes: put the blimp on a flat horizontal block or platform (or move it so it isn’t touching the arch) so the upward force isn’t redirected and it will go straight up.
